name: Faktura
description: Faktura is the autonomous invoice-financing desk on Casper. An AI agent underwrites real-world invoices, a native-CSPR pool funds them, and every AI decision is hash-anchored on-chain.

name: CSPR402
description: CSPR402 turns a verified Casper payment into an agent-friendly checkout flow, unlocking a simulated virtual card after on-chain payment verification.

name: CasCet
description: CasCet turns MCP servers into paid services with x402 micropayments on Casper, including composable multi-hop agent-to-agent payment chains.

name: Claros
description: Claros is a verifiable real-world-data oracle on Casper, with autonomous agents attesting data on-chain and selling machine-payable reads over x402.

name: ATLAS
description: Atlas is a non-custodial AI treasury agent on Casper that researches DeFi opportunities, buys verifiable risk data over x402, and proposes real trades for users to sign.

name: AgentEscrow402
description: AgentEscrow402 provides trustless payment infrastructure for AI agent commerce using on-chain Casper smart-contract escrows with auditable settlement and dispute handling.

name: Casper Trust Layer
description: Casper Trust Layer gives AI agents on-chain spending limits and counterparty trust rules, using reputation earned from settled payments to control who an agent may pay.

name: Sluice
description: Sluice is a streaming x402 meter for the agent economy, letting agents rent continuous resources and pay per second on Casper while access stops when payment stops.

name: Lastre
description: Lastre is an origin trust layer for real-world assets on Casper, using deterministic seals to verify origin before tokenization or finance and anchoring the result on-chain.

name: ARIA
description: ARIA is an autonomous RWA underwriting and liquidity protocol on Casper, using an AI council to analyze invoices, vote on-chain, mint collateralized assets, and route DeFi capital.

name: Pico Casper
description: Pay-per-unlock links for creators: the same link takes one tap from a human or an x402 round trip from an AI agent, settled in native CSPR.

name: Silicon DNA × Phoenix Zero
description: Silicon DNA × Phoenix Zero is an execution oracle that helps AI agents assess network safety before transactions or payments, monitoring 12 networks including Casper Mainnet.
latestMilestone: Live Monitoring of 12 Networks, Including Casper Mainnet

name: Veridex Protocol
description: Veridex Protocol provides open-source infrastructure for secure AI agent payments and commerce, combining identity, spending controls, service discovery, and verifiable transactions across multiple blockchains.
latestMilestone: Trust Rail Integrated into Veridex Protocol

name: Chainleash
description: Chainleash is an AI-powered CSPR staking agent that automates delegation and rebalancing under on-chain security rules, including validator allowlists, spending limits, and owner-controlled withdrawals.
latestMilestone: Live Testnet Staking Agent with On-Chain Safeguards

name: LeaseFi
description: Records real estate related transaction settlements on Casper. Property listings, lease/ownership agreements, maintenance, and wallet-to-wallet payments in USD stablecoin. LeaseFi is an all-in-one RWA platform.
latestMilestone: 8 Smart Contracts Deployed on Casper Testnet
